First, I need to know the travel distance and estimated travel time from my home in New York to my office in Boston, considering the current traffic conditions. Second, I am interested in finding out the top 5 chess players in San Francisco with a minimum rating of 2500. Lastly, I am working on a project and need to retrieve the historical GDP data for Japan from the year 2000 to 2020. Can you assist me with these?"
